result: Actual signature-(7,7) exterior/Hodge degree-2/12 bridge and square law, connected to the frozen finite-coordinate interface.
proved: B is bijective and diagonal +1 on indices 0..6, -1 on 7..13 in the ordered coordinate basis.
The actual top exterior wedge has volume +1.
H is exactly pinned Mathlib exteriorPower.hodgeStar and satisfies its actual wedge-pairing identity.
H_k(e_I)=eps(I)mu(I_complement)e_(I_complement) for all complementary degrees; extended to arbitrary forms.
S_k(e_I)=eps(I)mu(I)e_(I_complement), with the alpha-wedge-star pairing identity and H=-S.
H_12(H_2 x)=-x and S_12(S_2 x)=-x for all degree-2 forms; H_2(H_12 y)=-y for all degree-12 forms.
Named actual exterior-basis coordinates use a subset-to-Fin equivalence; both H and S coefficient arrays represent the frozen linearCoeff interface.
eps({0,1})=eps({0,7})=+1, giving S coefficients +1,-1 and H coefficients -1,+1.
The form e_{0,1} is nonzero and its H square is unequal to itself.
numerical_evidence: None substituted for proof. Finite sign and permutation checks use proof-producing Lean decide and are replayed by leanchecker.
